description: [Experimental web session] List the app's AppMetrica web workspaces (dashboards): system ones (id "<appId>/General" = Overview, "<appId>/Audience", ...) and custom ones. Returns dashboard_id, name, is_system, preset_kind, number of groups and widgets. Uses the unofficial AppMetrica web API through a headless Chrome session: run `npx appmetrica-mcp login` once to log in to Yandex.
name: web_list_workspaces
